name: @amykit/plugin-notify-fanout
description: Posts announcements to a mounted conversation, or fans them out through configured channels when no conversation is mounted.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Every workflow that announces needs the notifier port, and this plugin mounts it. When a conversation such as slack or telegram is mounted, announcements go into the work's thread there; otherwise they fan out to every channel other plugins contribute, such as notify-inbox and notify-hermes. A channel that fails is written to the log and to stderr.
